dedupe_keys.name: beopt building energy optimization tool residential

description: BEopt evaluates residential building designs and finds cost-optimal efficiency packages at increasing levels of whole-house energy savings, up to producing enough energy to offset demand. It handles new construction and retrofits of single-family detached and multifamily units through single designs, parametric sweeps and cost-based optimisation, and runs EnergyPlus through OpenStudio-HPXML with assumptions from ANSI/RESNET/ICC standards and the Building America House Simulation Protocols. Version 3.1.1 beta, released on 14 May 2026, updates to OpenStudio-HPXML 1.12.0 and EnergyPlus 25.2, improves heat pump and air conditioner defaults, and adds desuperheaters, pilot lights, load shifting, battery scheduling and demand response controls. Coverage: U.S. housing, with realistic U.S. construction options. Access: free setup file. Licence: users agree to the NLR data disclaimer. Caveats: the current release is a beta and options reflect U.S. practice. Simulation uses: least-cost retrofit and new-build packages and grid-interactive home scenarios. Related records: EnergyPlus, ResStock and OpenStudio.
